item.title: [Malayalam] [Web Series] Eyes
item.description:
Source91Mobiles Series
LanguageMalayalam
CategoryWeb Series
Release Date09 Oct 2026

The series follows Tina Sebastian, a police officer investigating disturbing cases involving women. As the investigation progresses, mental health professionals join forces with the police to understand the psychology of stalkers, identify warning signs and prevent situations from escalating. The show explores obsession, vulnerability and the increasingly blurred boundaries between affection, control and fear.
